correctness.rationale: The Hardy Hankel corner in the specified bases is [[conj(a),conj(b)],[conj(b),0]]. With b nonzero its norm is |b|Λ, where Λ−Λ⁻¹=|a|/|b|=t, as follows from the trace and determinant of the Gram matrix. Aligning bw with a gives the kernel profile F_t(r)=(1−r²)((t+r)²+1). Writing s=Λ⁻², at r=√s/2 the squared quotient is (1−s/4)(1+s²/4), differing from 25/27 by (8−3s)(3s−2)²/432. At s=2/3 this radius is the actual maximum by the derivative test and strict concavity for t>0, so the sharpness and sole mixed equality class are valid. Pure monomials attain ratio one at w=0. The Garsia identification uses T_{conj ψ}k_w=conj(ψ(w))k_w and orthogonal projection. Read the finite checker and verification note; the quoted tests are not a substitute for this all-coefficient computation.
